notes.title: Update Notes for 8/5/2023
notes.notes:
- Fixed an error that prevented achievements from working after a previous update. 
When you launch the game after the update,
you will automatically receive the achievements you earned during the error period.
I will pay more attention to ensure that the achievement error does not occur again.
I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

I want to thank all of you who play the game.
Please take care of your health in this hot summer, and I wish you happiness always.

notes.title: Update Chinese translation and Edit English translation
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm the developer of the memoir, 7757.

Thanks to Team BPMF, a translation club of NTNU Korean Course,
Memoir are starting to support Chinese.
You can select Traditional/Simplified Chinese from the Game Main Menu [Language].

In addition, some English translation up to Chapter 2 has been modified.

Thank you so much to everyone who played the game.
Take care of your health in the hot summer and always be happy.

notes.title: English Update
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm the developer of the memoir, 7757.

Thanks to your love and interest, Memoir are starting to support English.

I always thank all the users who play.

notes.title: Urgent updates regarding achievement errors
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm the creator of <Memoir>, 7757.

There is an error in the current game where the Steam achievements is not achieved properly.
I am having a hard time fixing it because I haven't found the cause yet.

As a temporary measure, we've added space to identify achievements in the in-game gallery.
The achievements are not recognized on Steam right now,
When you run an updated game after the error is corrected in the future
Achievements achieved will be recognized at once.

In addition, the image was changed due to duplicate answers in Chapter 3 puzzle design.

I'm sorry for bothering you.
Thank you to all the users who are playing.
